The `finalizedAt` fallback is covered after T: the open round read in tests/work-graph/S2B-30-track-bars.test.ts:168-170 has no finalizedAt (evidence-service.ts:355-358 writes it only when finalizing), and readCheckStart runs for rounds_open at track-read-model.ts:744. So the uncovered arm 1 is `origin.value.since ?? null`. A persisted null since is refused by the codec (decision-record-codecs.ts:394), and every creating commit binds since to the commit cursor (evidence-service.ts:351-358, :1697-1702); preservedRoundNoticeOrigin only copies an existing value (:305-316). Only a legacy or hand-edited stored round reaches the null, i.e. the U shape; Codex's 待定 is right that the list has no column, but the covered sibling fixes the arm.
